name: Vimeo
label: Vimeo API 3.4
description: Official Vimeo REST API 3.4 via OfficialApiNode. Base https://api.vimeo.com. extraHeaders send Accept: application/vnd.vimeo.*+json;version=3.4 (https://developer.vimeo.com/api/common-formats). Operations: video_get, video_list, video_upload (placeholder POST /me/videos only — tus binary is out of band), folder_list (/me/projects), trigger (ingress). Auth secret access_token is instance config only. Official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. video_get needs video_id. video_list/folder_list accept page, per_page. video_upload accepts name, description. OfficialApiNode does not stream tus bytes. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"video_get","video_id":"258684937"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'video_get' | 'video_list' | 'video_upload' | 'folder_list' | 'trigger'. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP. Example: 'video_get'.

schema.label: video_id
schema.description: Numeric Vimeo clip id or URI tail for video_get (path /videos/{video_id}). Strip a leading /videos/ if present. Required for video_get. Example: '258684937'.

schema.label: page
schema.description: 1-based page for video_list and folder_list. Omit = provider default. Example: 1.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Page size for video_list and folder_list. Vimeo max 100. Example: 25.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Video title. video_upload. Example: Launch recap.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Query-string parameter `fields` for operations: video_get, video_list, folder_list.

schema.label: upload
schema.description: Vimeo upload object for video_upload POST /me/videos. Official tus approach: {"approach":"tus","size":12345}. The actual tus bytes go to upload.upload_link (second step — not this HTTP call). https://developer.vimeo.com/api/upload/videos

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Never includes access_token. trigger returns a BPMN message-event instruction. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed Vimeo JSON (clip, paging list, or project list).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official Vimeo verb. EXACT: video_get | video_list | video_upload | folder_list | trigger. trigger is BPMN ingress, not a socket. Default video_get.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Vimeo OAuth access token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer (StudioQuack secret). Never on INPUT, never logged. Empty → error. Upload/private clips need matching scopes (upload, edit, private).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 60. Floor 1. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget.
